data.name: Ritambh
data.gender_notes: Ritambh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes the rhythm of truth in Hinduism. The name Ritambh carries the meaning “Truthful rhythm” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ritambh usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful rhythm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ritambh belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful rhythm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ritambh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
